categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes what the mining interface exposes and how templates are synchronized in node/interfaces.cpp, rather than IPC infrastructure itself.
categories.rationale: PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes or how templates are managed belong to mining rather than ipc.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies CBlockTemplate, block_template_manager, and the interfaces::Mining interface definition and capnp binding.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads can modify an active template during `submitSolution()` while another thread reads it. It also improves mining interface efficiency by providing `getTotalFees()` directly instead of requiring external clients to sum individual transaction fees across IPC.
